description: Gate 1.5 / Gate 2.5 second-model Architect review. Provider/model configurable: the current defaults use opencode-go/mimo, but any configured model id can replace them; the agent runner is an adapter, not a framework dependency. DEFAULT runner is the direct provider call (scripts/dev/architect_review.py run = one LLM call, no tools, lowest cost/latency). The sub-agent launch_command is OPT-IN for cases that need code investigation (BI-PF-1449).
design_checklist: Reversibility & backup: is the change reversible, and is a verified backup/restore path defined before any destructive step?
Availability & single-point-of-failure: what happens if the scheduler/worker/DB is down; is there defence-in-depth (on-startup check) and an alert lead-time?
Authorization & privilege boundary: is authz enforced at the boundary, and do runtime roles stay subject to RLS (no BYPASSRLS/superuser inheritance)?
Blast radius & dry-run: do destructive operations have bounds, a dry-run/report mode, and never touch current/future data?
Invariants & ordering: are keys/ids/sequence/ordering invariants stated and tested?
Tests & rollback: does the change have fail-able tests, and is rollback / migration-interrupted recovery covered?
Language rule: new shipped logic is Go; edits to shipped Python are allowed; tooling/tests/config/docs may be Python.
API & contracts: is needs_api decided; if yes, method/path/authn/authz/validation/tenant-scoping defined and contracts in sync?
Data & tenant isolation: is tenant/RLS scope, redaction/retention, and no-cross-tenant-leakage stated?
Reuse & observability: does it reuse existing owners/ports (no duplicate), and emit the minimum metrics/logs to diagnose failure?
AC/FR quality: every AC has exactly one matching FR with the same mode, preconditions, outcome, and failure behavior; no AC/FR contradiction.
Mode completeness: on/off/dual/shadow behavior is defined for the capability, or N/A with a reason; no undefined mode fallback.
Evidence quality: each AC has a distinct executable test or runbook artifact; unrelated/reused evidence is invalid.
Security/tenant proof: runtime role is NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS and tenant binding is explicitly tested.
Operational completeness: availability/SPOF, blast radius/dry-run, ID/sequence invariants, rollback, and operator recovery are answered.
launch_command: opencode run --agent {agent} --model {model} -f "{prompt_file}" "Perform the architect review in the attached file; output only the BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR/NIT/SUMMARY sections."
override: Per run: --model <id> or env PF_ARCHITECT_REVIEW_MODEL (takes precedence over this file).

review_budget.note: Gate 2.5 full-review budget: delta fix reviews do not count. Warn above warn_after and fail a completion above fail_after since the Gate 1 epoch unless a HIL-attested review_churn decision cites the latest full review sha.
